book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Sises oh Lihen Sameria men
Eri, Parisi ko ahpw rongadahr me Sises ketin papidaisihalahr oh sapwellimanikilahr tohnpadahk tohtohsang tohnpadahk en Sohn.
(A ni mehlel, pein Sises sohte ketin papidaisihala emen, a sapwellime tohnpadahk kohte.)
Ni ahnsou me Sises ketin mwahngihadahr koasoi pwoatet, e ahpw ketila sang Sudia oh ketin pwuralahng Kalili.
Eri, ni eh ketiket kohla, e uhdahn pahn kotehla Sameria.
Eri, e ahpw ketin lellahng ni kahnimw en Sameria ehu, me adaneki Saikar, me sohte dohsang sahpwo me Seikop kihong nah pwutak Sosep.
Iei wasa me pwarer en Seikop mi ie. Eri, Sises ngirekilahr eh ketin sapasapal kohla, e ahpw ketin kommoaldi pohn pwarero. Met kereniongehr nin souwas.
A lihen Sameria men ahpw kodohng idipil. Sises eri ketin mahsanihong liho, “Kihdo mahs nimei ekis pihlen.”
(Pwe sapwellime tohnpadahk ko patolahngehr nan kahnimwo, pwe re en pwainda konotarail.)

Lihen Sameriao ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Ia duwe, komwi mehn Suhs men, oh ngehi mehn Sameria men, a komwi ahpw kak peki pihl rehi?” (Pwehki mehn Suhs akan sohte kin doadoahngki dahl akan me mehn Sameria kan kin doadoahngki.)
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ma ke ese duwen kalahngan en Koht, oh ihs ih me peki pihl rehmw, a ke pahn peki pihl reh, oh e pahn kihong uhk pihl momour.”
Liho eri patohwanohng, “Maing, sohte sapwellimomwi pekid, oh pwarer wet me loal; a ia wasa me komwi pahn idipasang ie pihlen?
Ia duwe, komwi lapasang samatail Seikop me ketikihongkitehr pwarer wet? Me ih, oh nah pwutak ko, iangahki nah mahn akan, irail koaros kin nimpil sang pwarer wet.”
Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Aramas koaros me kin nimpil sang ni pihl wet pahn pwurehng men nimpilda;

ahpw mehmen me nimpil sang ni pihl wet me I pahn kihong solahr pahn pwurehng men nimpilda kohkohlahte. Pihlo me I pahn kihong, pahn poad loale oh wiahla pwapwangkadahn pihl me pahn kuskusdahng mour soutuk.”
Liho ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, komw ketikihong ie pihlen, pwe I en dehr pwurehng men nimpilda, oh I en dehr pwurodohng idipil wasa kiset.”
Sises eri ketin mahsanihong liho, “Kohwei, kahrehdo omw pwoud oh pwurodo wasa kiset.”
Liho ahpw patohwanohng, “Sohte ei pwoud.” Sises eri ketin mahsanih, “Me pwung omw koasoien, ‘Sohte ei pwoud;’
pwehki ke pwoudikier ohl limmen, oh ohl me ke pwoudiki ahnsou wet, kaidehn uhdahn omw pwoud. Met me mehlel me ke ndahn.”
Liho ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, I ahpw eseier me komwi soukohp men.
Samat ako kin kaudok pohn nahna wet, a kumwail mehn Suhs kin nda me dene Serusalemte, iei wasa me aramas pahn kaudokohng Koht ie.”
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanih, “Lih kamehlele ie, ahnsou pahn leledo me aramas solahr pahn kaudok ong Sahmo pohn nahna wet, de pil nan Serusalem.
Kumwail mehn Sameria kan sohte ese ihs me kumwail kin kaudokiong; a kiht mehn Suhs, se ese ihs ih me se kin kaudokiong; pwe komouro kin pwarodo sang mehn Suhs akan.
Ahpw ahnsou pahn leledo, oh e lelehr, me tohn kaudok mehlel kan pahn kaudokiong Sahmo ni ngehn oh mehlel, pwe iei soangen tohn kaudok kan me Sahmo ketin kupwurki en kaudokiong ih.
Ngehn ehu Koht, oh me kin kaudokiong re en kaudongki ngehn oh mehlel.”
Liho ahpw patohwanohng, “I ese me Mesaia, me nanmwarki Krais, pahn ketido. E lao ketido, e pahn ketin mahsanihong kitail mehkoaros.”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Iei ngehi ih, me koasoakoasoi ong uhk.”

Eri, ni ahnsowohte sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw pwurodo oh pwuriamweikihla eh ketin mahmahsen ong lih emen. Eri soh, sohte emen sang nanpwungarail me ndaiong liho, “Dahme ke anahne?” de patohwan idek rehn Sises, “Dahme kahrehda komw ketin mahmahsenkihong lihen?”
Liho ahpw pwilikihdi eh pwoatol en pihlo, ahpw pwurolongala nan kahnimwo oh ndaiong aramas ako,
“Kumwail kohdo kilang ohl emen me koasoia ong ie mehkoaros me I wiadahr. Ia duwe, kaidehn ih Krais?”
Re ahpw kohieila sang nan kahnimwo, kohla rehn Sises.
Ni ahnsowohte sapwellime tohnpadahk ko patohwanohng, “Maing Sounpadahk, komw ketin konot.”
E ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Mie ei tungoal kisin mwenge me I pahn tungoale, soangen mwenge me kumwail sohte ese.”
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw tapihada peipeidekpene nanpwungarail, “Ia duwe, mie me patohwandohng konote?”
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “Ei kapwaiada kupwur en ih me ketin poaroneiehdo, oh wiahda sapwellime doadoahk, iei me ei tungoal.
Mie ehu koasoi me kumwail kin nda: ‘Sounpwongte pahieu luhwe, eri, iei ahnsoun dolung.’ A I ndaiong kumwail: kumwail sarada oh kilengwohng mwetuwel kan, wahrail kan mahier oh mwahuwongehr en dondol.
Me kin dolung, e kin ale pweinen eh doadoahk, oh e kin dolung ong mour soutuk; pwe me kin padokedi oh me kin dolung ira koaros pahn pereperenpene.
Pwe mehlel koasoi pwoatet: ‘Emen kin padokedi, a emen kin dolung.’
Eri, I kadarkumwailwei pwe kumwail en dolung rahk nan mwetuwel kan me kumwail sohte koadoahkihada. Ekei me koadoahkihadahr, a kumwail pahn paieki arail doadoahk.”
Mehn Sameria tohtohie me pwosonla Sises sang nan kahnimwo, pwehki sang ni en liho eh nda, “E ketin koasoia ong ie mehkoaros me I wiadahr.”
Eri, ni ahnsou me mehn Sameria ko patohdo reh, re patohwan ngidingid peki pwe en ketikette rehrail. Sises ahpw ketiket rehrail erein rahn riau.
Eri, me tohto pil pwosonlahr pwehki sapwellime mahsen.
Re ahpw ndaiong liho, “Met se pwoson, kaidehn pwehki sang ni omw koasoi, ahpw pwehki at pein rongehr; iei me se esehkier me ih me uhdahn Sounkomourpen sampah.”
Sises Kakehlahda Nein Kaun emen Pwutak
Mwurin eh ketin kousoankier wasao erein rahn riau, Sises ahpw ketida sang wasao ketilahng Kalili.
Pwe pein Sises ketin mahsanih, “Soukohp men sohte kin ndand nan uhdahn eh wasa.”

Eri, ni eh lelehr Kalili, aramas akan en wasao ahpw kasamwo, pwehki arail kilangehr soahng koaros me e ketin wiadahr ni ahnsoun Sarawien Pahsohpa nan Serusalem; pwe pein irail iangehr towehda kamadipwo.
Eri, Sises pwuralahng Kena nan Kalili, wasa me e ketin kawekalahr pihl oh wiahkihla wain. Eri, lapalap en wehi men mie Kapernaum, me nah pwutak soumwahudahr.
Ni ohlo eh rongada me Sises ketidohngehr Kalili sang nan Sudia, e ahpw pwarala reh, oh peki pwe en ketilahng Kapernaum oh kakehlahda nah pwutako me kereniongehr mehla.
Sises eri ketin mahsanihong, “Sohte mehmen nanpwungamwail kak kamehlele ma kumwail sohte kilang manaman lapalap oh kapwuriamwei kan.”
Me lapalapo ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing, komw ketin iangiehla mwohn ei tungoal pwutako eh pahn mehla.”
Sises eri mahsanih, “Kohwei, noumw pwutako momour.” Ohlo eri pwoson mahsen en Sises ahpw patopatohla.
Nindokon en ohlo eh pwurodohng ni imweo, nah ladu ko ahpw tuhkihong ih rohng me nah pwutako momour.
Ohlo ahpw kalelapak rehrail ni ahnsou da me e tapihada mwahula. Re ahpw nda, “Aio, kulok ehu mwurin souwas, karakaro kohsang.”
Sahmo ahpw tamanda me iei ahnsowo me Sises ketin mahsanihong, “Noumw pwutako momour.” Eri, pein ih oh eh peneinei koaros ahpw pwosonla.
Met iei keriaun doadoahk manaman me Sises ketin wiahda mwurin eh ketidohng Kalili sang nan Sudia.
